title: Sling Group Holdings Ltd Ordinary Shares 08285
CSI Floorings (HK) Limited completed the acquisition of 12.11% stake in Sling Group Holdings Limited from Yen Sheng Investment Limited.
Tan Suqin a finalisé l’acquisition d’une participation de 40 % dans Sling Group Holdings Limited (SEHK:8285) auprès de Yen Sheng Investment Limited.
CSI Floorings (HK) Limited entered into agreeent to acquire 12.11% stake in Sling Group Holdings Limited from Yen Sheng Investment Limited for HKD 9.7 million.
